import Mathlib.Algebra.MonoidAlgebra.Degree
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Eval
import Mathlib.Order.ConditionallyCompleteLattice.Finset
import Mathlib.Basic.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finsupp.Weight
import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPowerSeries.NoZeroDivisors
import Mathlib.Tactic
#check_failure Roth.index_prod
namespace IndexProdMathlib145
universe u v
theorem modern {σ : Type u} {R : Type v} [CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R]
    [Nontrivial R] {ι : Type*} (w : σ → ℕ) (f : ι → MvPowerSeries σ R) (s : Finset ι) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, f i).weightedOrder w = ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).weightedOrder w :=
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_prod w f s
theorem polynomial {σ : Type u} {R : Type v} [CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R]
    [Nontrivial R] {ι : Type*} (w : σ → ℕ) (f : ι → MvPolynomial σ R) (s : Finset ι) :
    ((∏ i ∈ s, f i : MvPolynomial σ R) : MvPowerSeries σ R).weightedOrder w =
      ∑ i ∈ s, (f i : MvPowerSeries σ R).weightedOrder w := by
  change (MvPolynomial.coeToMvPowerSeries.ringHom (∏ i ∈ s, f i)).weightedOrder w = _
  rw [map_prod, MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_prod]
#check @MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_prod
#check @MvPowerSeries.order_prod
#check @MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_one
#check @MvPolynomial.coeToMvPowerSeries.ringHom
#check_failure ENat.toNat_sum
#check_failure AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree_prod
#print axioms modern
#print axioms polynomial
end IndexProdMathlib145
